description: Iris V2 — drill into one agent profile. Use the profile selector at the top to filter every panel. Backed by the operational event log (read via the audit-db Postgres mirror — Phase 6.x will add direct SQLite access).

panels.description: Total events for the selected profile in the time window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(*) AS total FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Events for $profile

panels.description: Outcome breakdown. Anything red means failures need investigation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, COUNT(*) AS count FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY count DESC

panels.title: Outcomes for $profile

panels.description: Distinct resources (skills, tools, mcp servers) this profile touched.

targets.rawSql: SELECT NOW() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_id) AS total FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()

panels.title: Distinct resources

panels.description: Activity over time, broken down by action verb. Spikes indicate burst work; flat regions indicate idle profile.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, $__interval) AS time, action AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $profile — actions over time

panels.description: Top resources this profile interacted with. Use this to spot which skills/tools/MCP servers are pulling weight (and which aren't).

targets.rawSql: SELECT resource_type AS type, resource_id AS resource, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'ok') AS ok, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome != 'ok') AS errors FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Top resources for $profile

panels.description: Profile-tagged spans + log lines from OTel + Promtail. Filtered to this profile only.
panels.title: $profile — recent telemetry (Loki)

panels.description: Recent failures. If a pattern emerges (same resource_id repeatedly failing), that's a candidate for the iris-lessons skill or a guardrail.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts, action, resource_type AS "resource type", resource_id AS resource, outcome, payload->>'error_class' AS "error class" FROM audit_log WHERE profile = '$profile' AND outcome != 'ok' AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: $profile — recent failures

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM audit_log ORDER BY profile
list.label: profile
list.name: profile
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT profile FROM audit_log ORDER BY profile
